args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after the latest production deploy (v2.3.1), showing an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up needed to investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-deploying.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Checked the deployment history and current status. `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, failing health checks across all regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified the service is now **healthy** in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0" — with a summary describing the failure and the rollback mitigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

A follow-up root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 will still be needed before it can be safely re-deployed.
